description: Source code implementing audio sink helper functions and test environment classes for audio buffer management and testing in the starboard/nplb namespace.

classes.name: AudioSinkTestFrameBuffers
classes.description: Manages audio frame buffers for testing, supporting different sample and storage types.

classes.name: AudioSinkTestEnvironment
classes.description: Provides a test environment for audio sink, managing buffer states, synchronization, and callbacks.

methods.name: GetAnySupportedSampleType
methods.description: Returns a supported audio sample type, preferring deprecated int16 if supported, otherwise float32.

methods.name: GetAnySupportedFrameStorageType
methods.description: Returns a supported audio frame storage type, preferring interleaved if supported, otherwise planar.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes buffer sizes based on supported formats and buffer requirements.

methods.name: AudioSinkTestEnvironment
methods.description: Constructor that creates an audio sink with specified frame buffers.

methods.name: SetIsPlaying
methods.description: Sets the playing state of the audio sink.

methods.name: AppendFrame
methods.description: Appends frames to the buffer in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: GetFrameBufferFreeSpaceInFrames
methods.description: Returns free space in frames in the buffer.

methods.name: WaitUntilUpdateStatusCalled
methods.description: Waits until the source status update callback is called.

methods.name: WaitUntilSomeFramesAreConsumed
methods.description: Waits until some frames are consumed.

methods.name: WaitUntilAllFramesAreConsumed
methods.description: Waits until all appended frames are consumed, appending silence if needed.

methods.name: OnUpdateSourceStatus
methods.description: Callback to update buffer status and state variables.

methods.name: OnConsumeFrames
methods.description: Callback to update frames consumed count.
